name: 左文右圖＋圖片下緣被區塊裁切
desc: 左側是大標題、副標、說明文字與一組按鈕，右側一張直式圖片靠下，下緣貼齊區塊下緣並被裁切。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的區塊。左右兩欄，內容對齊頁面內容寬度：左側文字欄約佔六成，靠上對齊；右側放一張直式圖片，約佔內容寬度的兩成多，靠下對齊，圖片頂端低於大標題，圖片下緣貼齊區塊下緣、被區塊下緣裁切，只露出上半大部分。文字欄由上而下是大標題（可多行）、副標與說明文字段落，大標題是區塊裡最大的元素，明顯大於副標；說明文字下方可放一組並排的按鈕，按鈕下方可放一段小字次要文字，沒有時省略，其他元素的位置不變。
mobile: 改為直向堆疊：大標題、副標與說明文字段落在上，橫跨內容寬度；下方仍分左右兩邊，左側按鈕改為直向堆疊，下方接小字次要文字，右側直式圖片下緣仍貼齊區塊下緣並被裁切。

en.name: Text left, image right + image cropped by the section bottom
en.desc: On the left are a headline, subheading, description and a set of buttons; on the right a single portrait image sits low, flush with the section's bottom edge and cropped by it.
en.prompt: Create a section whose height is determined by its content. Two columns aligned to the page content width: the text column on the left takes about sixty percent and is aligned to the top; the right column holds a single portrait image taking a little over twenty percent of the content width, aligned to the bottom, with its top starting below the headline. The image's bottom edge is flush with the section's bottom edge and is cropped by it, so only most of its upper part shows. From top to bottom the text column has a headline (may wrap to multiple lines), a subheading and a description paragraph; the headline is the largest element in the section, noticeably larger than the subheading. Optionally place a set of side-by-side buttons below the description, and a short line of small secondary text below the buttons; omit them when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the desktop layout.
en.mobile: Stacks vertically: the headline, subheading and description paragraph come first, spanning the content width; below them the layout stays split into left and right, with the buttons stacked vertically on the left followed by the small secondary text, and the portrait image on the right, its bottom edge still flush with the section's bottom edge and cropped by it.
